336.s: These pantalette fliarriages never turn out well.
When she printed her initials, they looked like the pointed pantalette edging in the portrait of her grandmother when she, too, was a little girl.
How would I feel, dancing about before those young men, in this child's dress, with only the edge of the pantalette showing below it!
